title: Turn Cinematic
description: Give characters a faction (Prophet, Angel, Liquidator or Survivor). When it becomes their turn in combat, a cinematic plays: faction background video, their portrait, their name, and a faction sound. Each faction has its own composition and typeface (the Prophet's seal, parchment and rays are pictures you can replace); Angels float straight over the game, as horrors with grades D-C-B-A: stamped onto the screen, with wings and halos, and hands reaching in at the top grades.
